name: Get all your WhatsApp activity (unaggregated events)
description: Get all your WhatsApp activity (unaggregated events). This endpoint will show the unaggregated statistics for WhatsApp activity (30 days by default if `startDate` and `endDate` or `days` is not passed. The date range can not exceed 90 days)

limit.description: Number limitation for the result returned

offset.description: Beginning point in the list to retrieve from

startDate.description: **Mandatory if endDate is used.** Starting date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be lower than equal to endDate

endDate.description: **Mandatory if startDate is used.** Ending date of the report (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be greater than equal to startDate

days.description: Number of days in the past including today (positive integer). _Not compatible with 'startDate' and 'endDate'_

contactNumber.description: Filter results for specific contact (WhatsApp Number with country code. Example, 85264318721)

event.title: WhatsappStatisticsEventsGetParametersEvent
event.description: Filter the report for a specific event type

sort.title: WhatsappStatisticsEventsGetParametersSort
sort.description: Sort the results in the ascending/descending order of record creation. Default order is **descending** if `sort` is not passed

body.description: Text of the reply (will be there only in case of `reply` event with text)

date.description: UTC date-time on which the event has been generated

mediaUrl.description: Url of the media reply (will be there only in case of `reply` event with media)

messageId.description: Message ID which generated the event
